Link interaction fixture — no accounts required

Serve only through the approved HTTPS fixture host. These links use that host, except explicitly invalid-scheme cases.

  • Ordinary same-tab GET
  • target=_blank GET
  • HTTPS redirect endpoint (fixture must supply 302)
  • Right-click: tab, window, Save Link As, copy, inspect
  • Unsupported script link: navigation/save disabled, explicit copy allowed
  • Unsupported mail application link
